issue.title: Expand host-file patterns in attachments import and ref create
issue.description: Landing audit at bob-cli 992fd33d: attachments/cli.rs execute_import passes raw String operands into capture_clip::plan_explicit_paths; capture_clip/files.rs classify_path_candidate expands tilde and then performs metadata lookup, with no glob. highlights_ref/create.rs retains mixed local-file, vault-note and URL routes and has no host_paths adoption. Command Mode spawns argv directly, so shells cannot supply expansion. All-status semantic search, past-week task sweep, and all 17 active epic scopes found no duplicate or causal owner. Scope requires planning across two independent route contracts, hence size large. The current bank helper has an epic-owned ./ glob bug that bob-cli-no closeout must repair first; this task must reuse its repaired behavior, not fork another expander.

task_type_fields.proposal: Adopt native::host_paths::expand_operands for host-file operands of bob attachments import and bob ref create, so literal quoted patterns supplied by Command Mode work consistently with bank import. Preserve existing literal-path precedence, attachment file:// decoding and size/count/sync safety, reference URL/vault-note routing, and all supported input contracts. Do not glob arbitrary command strings or vault-note/URL operands. First determine the supported multi-file ref-create behavior rather than silently treating a glob expansion like a URL collection.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: Proposed by bob-cli-no.1 note #1 and explicitly deferred in plan:202611/bank_import_delete.md. The bank epic adds the reusable helper but limits adoption to bank import. Other commands already handle some tilde cases; the remaining feature is safe shared host-file pattern handling without disturbing their distinct grammars.
